name: @mku1tra/que-harness
description: What runs que's plugins: the harness schema of que's ontology (agent, model, loop and deployment), which imports the plugin schema of @mku1tra/que-plugin, and whose types are the contract of a deployment and its configs; the reader of a deployment, the facts of a model from pi's model catalog, the sources that give its graph to its root's lint, and the schema of a deployment's own root.
